prompt: Question 30: Contrast the internal processing and training resource demands of an artificial neural network against an instance-based model like K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN).

prompt: Question 31: Explain the operational mechanics that occur behind the scenes when executing the .fit() and .predict() methods on a KNN object using an object-oriented library like scikit-learn.

prompt: Describe the differences between video streaming using hypertext transfer protocol (HTTP) and real time streaming protocol (RTSP).
correct_answer: RTSP uses bandwidth more efficiently because bandwidth is only used for parts of the video that are actually watched. HTTP delivery sends or caches the whole file to the computer. RTSP can support live streaming broadcasts and only caches a small packet of the file, while HTTP caches the entire file.

prompt: Describe the impact that an increased availability of bandwidth has had on the delivery of multimedia content online.

Music is also now commonly accessed online, increasing availability and reducing prices. However, increased bandwidth has also contributed to digital piracy, which can reduce income for authors and creators of digital content.
